Do not infer input trust or helper behavior from names. Missing external context is not proof of a defect. Any local_defect takes precedence, then context_required; locally_protected requires protection for every relevant operation. These labels describe local evidence, not production exploitability.

criteria.not_applicable: No security-relevant business invariant, server-owned decision, or controlled workflow transition is present.
criteria.locally_protected: Relevant authoritative values are derived or verified server-side, and every visible mutation enforces the applicable business invariant and permitted transition before taking effect.
criteria.local_defect: Visible code lets demonstrably untrusted data override an established authoritative value or violate a demonstrated business invariant, such as accepting a client price where a server price is authoritative or bypassing a required approval state.
criteria.context_required: A security-sensitive business operation is present, but intended rules, data provenance, upstream validation, or downstream invariant enforcement is insufficiently shown.
